name: Wall of Fire
description:
Concentration, up to 1 minute.

You create a wall of fire within medium range that is 15 ft high, 5 ft thick, and up to 30 ft long or circular with a diameter of short range. Uncheck any number of Conditions and roll Spirit to set the Difficulty.

Each creature that enters the wall, begins its turn within the wall or is within the wall when it's created must roll Dexterity against the Difficulty. On a failure, the creature takes 1d6+HEART damage. On a pass, it takes half damage and no further effects.

For each Condition you unchecked (twice for Angry), choose one:

  • The wall becomes 10 ft longer or taller, or the diameter increases by 10 ft.

  • +1d damage.

  • Whenever you maintain concentration for this spell, you may move the wall or part of the wall an additional 5 ft in any direction you choose.

Describe how you create the wall.
successes:
✨: Whenever a creature takes damage from the wall, it takes an additional 1d6 damage at the start of its next turn.

🌞: Whenever a creature takes damage from the wall, it also rolls Injury.
